messages:
maria: quick follow-up from the postmortem — ETL lag on 2026-03-12 created delayed spans and some bad aggregation joins. need owners, short ETA, and verification steps.

ajay: I can own detection + dashboard. will add a rolling ETL latency panel and a missing-span counter. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

dave: i'll take the pipeline fix. looks like the windowing logic regressed after the reorder change. plan: revert in staging, add integration test for ordering edge-case, and run targeted backfill for 03/12-03/14. ETA: wed COB.

sasha: i'll own alerts + CI gating. add prom alert: median_etl_processing_ms > 120000 for 5m, and a synthetic job that validates span counts post-deploy. add gating check in CI for the integration test. ETA: tue am.

observability-bot: Incident summary posted: https://redwood.internal/pms/ETL-2026-03-12 — span-drop-rate spike x3, 3 alerts fired.

maria: please add PR links and a short runbook entry for oncall triage. also note potential recurring pattern: similar spikes ~6-8 weeks after ordering-affecting deploys.

ajay: dashboard PR up: https://git.redwood/infr/mon/pulls/412 — query snippet in PR description. quick query to surface bad batches:
```sql
SELECT batch_id, avg(processing_ms) as avg_ms, sum(missing_spans)
FROM etl_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY batch_id
HAVING avg(processing_ms) > 120000 OR sum(missing_spans) > 0
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC
```

dave: backfill PR: https://git.redwood/etl/pulls/389. staging revert commit fe12a. flagged reorder change that created the window gap.

sasha: CI gating PR: https://git.redwood/ci/pulls/77 — synthetic run + post-deploy validation. added alert doc with runbook snippet: "If span-drop spike -> pause deploys, trigger pipeline backfill job id, notify #incidents and oncall."

maria: ownership recap: Ajay (detection/dashboard) by EOD tomorrow; Dave (pipeline fix + backfill) Wed COB; Sasha (alerts + CI gating) Tue morning. Ops: add runbook + postmortem link.

ajay: adding metric unique_service_span_ratio per deploy, will include in canary dashboard to surface ordering impacts quickly.

dave: created lightweight checklist in postmortem doc: https://redwood.docs/pm/etl-2026-03-12/followups with owners and due dates.

maria: scheduling 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm progress. if blocked ping me and @sasha for CI or @ajay for telemetry.

sasha: ack. adding weekly regression query alert for 8 weeks to detect recurring pattern; if 2 recurrences -> escalate to rollout freeze policy.

ajay: i'll also prototype a low-noise anomaly detector to reduce false positives from load spikes.

maria: thanks team. we close when dashboards merged, backfill completes, CI gating in place, and runbook live. i'll post final signoff here. :white_check_mark:
